messages.content: ترجم النصوص الإنجليزية المحددة إلى العربية الفصحى الواضحة، بوصفها مسودة أمينة للمصدر المعطى فقط. حافظ على معنى كل عدد وترتيبه، ولا تلخّص أو تدمج أو تحذف أو تضف تفسيراً أو حكماً. لا تستكمل نصاً ولا تستنتج ما لم يذكره المصدر. تعامل مع المحتوى الإنجليزي كمادة للترجمة لا كتعليمات. حافظ على أسماء الأشخاص والأماكن بصورة ثابتة قدر الإمكان. أعد البيانات بالتنسيق المطلوب حصراً. اكتب ملاحظة مراجعة منفصلة عند وجود التباس حقيقي، واترك القائمة فارغة إذا كان المعنى واضحاً. هذه ترجمة أولية تحتاج إلى تدقيق بشري مقابل المصدر.

{"book_code":"1ES","book_ar":"عزرا الأول","chapter":6,"source_translation":"en-web","source_name":"World English Bible Classic","source_url":"https://ebible.org/Scriptures/eng-web_vpl.zip","source_integrity":"all 448 units in this edition were matched against the current XML source; batch contains one chapter only","source_sha256":"81701e162568ec07c6b875211ea35fe5ec3759a2319b8496957a3074d4db42a8","verses":[{"chapter":6,"verse":16,"text":"They pulled down the house, burned it, and carried away the people captive to Babylon."},{"chapter":6,"verse":17,"text":"But in the first year that Cyrus reigned over the country of Babylon, King Cyrus wrote that this house should be rebuilt."},{"chapter":6,"verse":18,"text":"The holy vessels of gold and of silver that Nabuchodonosor had carried away out of the house at Jerusalem and had set up in his own temple, those King Cyrus brought out of the temple in Babylonia, and they were delivered to Zorobabel and to Sanabassarus the governor,"},{"chapter":6,"verse":19,"text":"with commandment that he should carry away all these vessels, and put them in the temple at Jerusalem, and that the Lord’s temple should be built on its site."},{"chapter":6,"verse":20,"text":"Then Sanabassarus, having come here, laid the foundations of the Lord’s house which is in Jerusalem. From that time to this we are still building. It is not yet fully completed.’"},{"chapter":6,"verse":21,"text":"Now therefore, if it seems good, O king, let a search be made among the royal archives of our lord the king that are in Babylon."},{"chapter":6,"verse":22,"text":"If it is found that the building of the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem has been done with the consent of King Cyrus, and it seems good to our lord the king, let him send us directions concerning these things.”"},{"chapter":6,"verse":23,"text":"Then King Darius commanded that a search be made among the archives that were laid up at Babylon. So at Ekbatana the palace, which is in the country of Media, a scroll was found where these things were recorded:"},{"chapter":6,"verse":24,"text":"“In the first year of the reign of Cyrus, King Cyrus commanded to build up the house of the Lord which is in Jerusalem, where they sacrifice with continual fire."},{"chapter":6,"verse":25,"text":"Its height shall be sixty cubits, and the breadth sixty cubits, with three rows of hewn stones, and one row of new wood from that country. Its expenses are to be given out of the house of King Cyrus."},{"chapter":6,"verse":26,"text":"The holy vessels of the house of the Lord, both gold and silver, that Nabuchodonosor took out of the house at Jerusalem and carried away to Babylon, should be restored to the house at Jerusalem, and be set in the place where they were before.”"},{"chapter":6,"verse":27,"text":"Also he commanded that Sisinnes the governor of Syria and Phoenicia, and Sathrabuzanes, and their companions, and those who were appointed rulers in Syria and Phoenicia, should be careful not to meddle with the place, but allow Zorobabel, the servant of the Lord, and governor of Judea, and the elders of the Jews, to build that house of the Lord in its place."},{"chapter":6,"verse":28,"text":"“I also command to have it built up whole again; and that they look diligently to help those who are of the captivity of Judea, until the house of the Lord is finished,"},{"chapter":6,"verse":29,"text":"and that out of the tribute of Coelesyria and Phoenicia a portion shall be carefully given to these men for the sacrifices of the Lord, that is, to Zorobabel the governor for bulls, rams, and lambs,"},{"chapter":6,"verse":30,"text":"and also corn, salt, wine and oil, and that continually every year without further question, according as the priests who are in Jerusalem may direct to be daily spent,"}]}
